proof_gap_convention: The main proof-gap count records invalid mathematical inferences in the text; adding absent formal proofs gives the separately reported inclusive count. The false implication and invalid inference are the same passage.

issues.conclusion: Construct the object of internal Dedekind reals and an epimorphism to it from the NNO in the parameterized realizability topos for the Miller sequence.
issues.downstream: Introductory topos comparison. The external Miller sequence needed by §9 has a witness.

issues.conclusion: In the given locally connected iteration category construct the Turing completion and its evaluator for the uniformly generated isotypical B-sharp subcategory.
issues.downstream: Introductory existence comparison; the concrete categories have independent evaluators.

issues.conclusion: Construct the absolute Turing completion and its universal morphism in a separated iteration category.
issues.downstream: Would follow by applying the relative theorem to the identity; no numbered proof requires that completion.

issues.conclusion: Construct relative developments under the faithful iteration functor into the separated target, obtain its weak evaluator and prove the Turing equation with equality of partial domains.
issues.downstream: Introductory attribution; the faithful model family has a separate proof.

issues.conclusion: Add nonzero identity to obtain the contradiction. The sole idempotent in the one-object, one-morphism category is a complementary separator.
issues.downstream: The unrestricted introductory implication is false. Corollary 3.3 has the needed nonzero hypothesis.

issues.conclusion: Construct the relevant internal AU and prove for every AU object of the initial arithmetic universe that syntactic completeness implies triviality.
issues.downstream: Introductory comparison. The signed and slice theorems do not require it.

issues.conclusion: For a consistent initial arithmetic universe prove that the equalizer of the indicated truth values is a subobject of 1 different from bottom.
issues.downstream: Introductory comparison. Arithmetic consistency is established with the designated model.
The independent diagonal proof is unaffected.

issues.conclusion: The existence of one recursive selector is a property of the fixed presentation. Unconditional existence for every consistent theory fails at the empty extension of a complete theory.
issues.downstream: Theorem 8.6 supplies the selector for the stated PA presentation.

issues.conclusion: The same proof uses d first as a natural-number oracle-machine domain index and later as the partial endomorphism obtained by diagonal application.
issues.downstream: The two local types and the equalities of domains and values are checked in Proposition C.1.
